method: FFN-only reuse unchanged. Fused compact FFN-input normalization and one shared inverse map for cache reconstruction. RGB rule, stable ranking, capacities, gates, FFN algorithms and evaluation schedule unchanged.

initial_40_pairs.protocol: One model and fixed FFN plans, separate old/new first-stage graphs and histories. Forty AB/BA pairs per budget and input sequence. CPU image/state through denormalized CPU actions. No stage instrumentation during timing.
initial_40_pairs.fixture: Original request and synthetic +64 modulo-256 RGB changes in 40/70/110 spatial tiles; not closed-loop.

confirmation_80_pairs.protocol: One model and fixed FFN plans, separate old/new first-stage graphs and histories. Eighty AB/BA pairs, CPU affinity 0-7 per budget and input sequence. CPU image/state through denormalized CPU actions. No stage instrumentation during timing.
confirmation_80_pairs.fixture: Original request and synthetic +64 modulo-256 RGB changes in 40/70/110 spatial tiles; not closed-loop.

paired.protocol: One shared model, fixed algorithms; alternate OFF/ON and ON/OFF; identical observation; forced 2F; not closed-loop.

audit_binding: One shared checkpoint, independent histories, first-stage graphs and VideoAdapter/ParallelJointLoop instances. Archived layer functions and old normalization kernel used for before. Audit-only import/registration aliases isolate old and current functions; normalization body and FFN configurations remain fixed.
limitations: Recorded fixture plus synthetic tile changes; not closed-loop or task-success evaluation.
Timing uses 32/120 refresh capacity. All four capacities checked for exact outputs separately.
GPU clocks not locked; shared workstation has resident IsaacSim/display processes. No background processes stopped.
Initial 2F static 40-pair bootstrap interval includes zero. Report all initial samples; confirmation uses 80 pairs per case and CPU affinity 0-7.
Before/after both enable reuse. ON/OFF stage diagnostics compare different approximation settings and are not equivalence tests.
Normalization microbenchmark uses explicit ATen gather; its isolated ratio does not represent the compiled end-to-end implementation.
Trace durations are profiled single requests; overlapping kernel sums are not end-to-end critical-path times.
Separate first-completion diagnostic inserts synchronization; not used for the before/after end-to-end table.
Paper Table 2 uses rollout means and its own execution baseline; this experiment does not reproduce the 5.50 ms paper delta.
Checkpoint, request fixtures and complete traces are not bundled.
